versions.changelog:
xhs-viral-post v1.0.2
- Fixed metadata mismatches: Declared OPENAI_API_KEY and SKILLPAY_KEY properly in SKILL.md YAML frontmatter.
- Added detailed setup instructions for environment variables and SkillPay billing.
- Improved transparency: Explicit disclosure of OpenAI calls and public Datamuse API (no auth needed).
- Enhanced content quality: More authentic Xiaohongshu style (first-person, emojis, hooks).
- Integrated SkillPay charge logic in run.js for per-call monetization.
- Removed non-text files for validation compliance.

- Updated pricing: each execution now costs 0.05 USDT (previously 0.008 USDT).
- No other functional changes made in this version.

XiaoHongShu Viral Post Generator 1.0.0

- Initial release of a tool for generating viral Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) posts using AI.
- Produces post titles, content, high-performing hashtags, cover image prompts, and posting strategy based on a given topic.
- Designed for content creators, marketers, and workflow automation.
- Outputs include recommendations on timing, engagement hooks, and audience targeting.
- Supports trigger phrases in both Chinese and English.
